knock.text: Three firm knocks on a heavy wooden hotel room door in a quiet corridor at night, close, dry, no music, no voices

door-open.text: An old heavy wooden hotel room door opening slowly with a soft creak, interior, close, no music, no voices

door-close.text: A heavy wooden hotel room door closing gently, ending with a soft latch click, interior, close, no music

growl.text: A large dog growling low and quiet from deep in its chest, steady and menacing, close microphone, no barking, no music

snow-steps.text: Two people walking slowly side by side over fresh snow at night in a quiet, empty old-town street, soft crunching footsteps, no voices, no traffic, no music

pummerin.text: A single toll of an enormous, very deep cathedral bell heard from a few streets away across a quiet snowy city at night, long resonant decay, no other bells, no music

clock-strike.text: A single strike of a large old tower clock bell, heard from inside the building through walls, deep and slightly muffled, resonant decay, no ticking, no music

rumble.text: A short deep rumble and shudder running through an old building as a heavy hidden mechanism releases, wood and stone, no music

shelf-opens.text: A heavy wooden bookshelf swinging open like a hidden door, slow deep wooden creak ending in a soft thud, interior, no music
